title: Restore canonical complaint form and explicit sales-order exception entry
description: Complete the sales-chain exception entry through the existing canonical complaint controller. BILL_CODE_MAP still maps complaint to a legacy stored-procedure family and takes precedence over the existing api/finance/complaints module; the legacy mutation gate deliberately denies writes. Select the canonical module without enabling old writers or mapping Oid to Id. FinanceComplaint.ComplaintNo is Required with empty default although Create assigns its number. Restore blank-number real MVC creation with server-owned ID/status, typed nullable source fields and the existing explicit sales-order selector/clear behavior. Keep current customer scope, complaint money bounds, source ownership and lifecycle; recording a complaint must not automatically refund, adjust stock or cancel orders. Test fixtures must generate ephemeral process-local JWT signing keys and authenticate through existing controls on fresh dedicated test databases. Browser evidence must use genuine permitted API writes; offline wiring assertions are not browser acceptance and must be labelled honestly. Keep build/test output and TRX under .ai/logs/<task>/ with explicit --results-directory; preserve original failures and never stage generated artifacts. Respect current business document page/basic-data drawer presentation. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: The existing authorized complaint menu chooses api/finance/complaints and canonical IDs, blank-number HTTP creation returns a server number/state, and save/reload/edit with explicit sales-order source selection/clearing round trips. Supported unlinked exception entry remains explicit; legacy history stays distinct and legacy writes fail closed.

Preserve live authority, customer/source checks, amount/currency bounds and lifecycle/source transactions. Invalid money, stale source, customer mismatch, revoked permission or forbidden state rejects before number reservation/write and changes no order, stock, refund or financial allocation record.

Genuine isolated SQL/HTTP verification covers binding, main-form round trip, linked/manual exception flow and zero-mutation rejection; browser proof is real authorized workflow or explicit non-execution. Preserve source-picker/lifecycle tests, safe Release/full units and original complete logs/TRX.
implementation_evidence: bill-v2.js retains complaint in BILL_CODE_MAP, while modules-finance.js:155-170 defines api/finance/complaints and complaint-sales-order-source. Finance2.cs FinanceComplaint.ComplaintNo is Required with empty default and FinanceReceiptComplaintControllers.Create assigns it via GenerateAsync. ERP-388/389 implements authoritative complaint lifecycle/source selection, not canonical primary menu/model binding.
